issues.summary: Need CLI command to update existing plan data-entry shape
issues.impact: Agents cannot safely correct stale Reconstructed data Size/Type metadata without hand-editing .agent/RECOIL_PLAN.md, which AGENTS.md forbids.
issues.next_action: Implement focused plan data-shape update command, then correct 0x4dcbfc to size 61/type char[0x3d] and 0x4dcc3c to size 56/type char[0x38].

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Fixed by adding plan update-data with evidence and dry-run support for existing data-entry Reconstructed shape fields. Parent validation passed, and 0x4dcbfc/0x4dcc3c were corrected then promoted through the accepted zReader mission path data owner.

issues.requested_change: Add a plan subcommand that updates an existing canonical data entry's Reconstructed Size and Type fields with evidence and dry-run support, preserving owner/reimplementation metadata and enforcing plan audit.
issues.benefit: Allows accepted BN/VC data-symbol evidence such as 0x4dcbfc/0x4dcc3c NUL-inclusive string extents to be recorded without unsafe manual plan edits.
issues.resolution: Fixed by adding plan update-data with evidence and dry-run support for existing data-entry Reconstructed shape fields. Parent validation passed, and 0x4dcbfc/0x4dcc3c were corrected then promoted through the accepted zReader mission path data owner.
